The box lists 110 stitch applications and 11 accessories included.
The actual sewing machine is not visible; only the illustration on the box is shown.
The box shows some signs of wear and handling.

risks.risk: The machine may be non-functional or have internal mechanical faults.

Video of the machine sewing a piece of fabric to demonstrate it works.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
